disbursements_handover_time_check.name: disbursements_handover_time_check
disbursements_handover_time_check.value: "disbursements"."handed_over_at" is not null or "disbursements"."handed_over_by" is null

items_asset_no_unique.name: items_asset_no_unique
items_asset_no_unique.where: "items"."deleted_at" is null and "items"."asset_no" is not null

items_serial_no_unique.name: items_serial_no_unique
items_serial_no_unique.where: "items"."deleted_at" is null and "items"."serial_no" is not null

items_depreciation_check.name: items_depreciation_check
items_depreciation_check.value: not "items"."depreciation_enabled" or coalesce(("items"."item_type"='asset' and "items"."depreciation_method"='straight_line' and "items"."depreciation_cost">1 and "items"."depreciation_useful_life_years">0 and "items"."depreciation_start_basis" in ('acquired','available','manual') and "items"."depreciation_start_date" is not null and "items"."depreciation_residual_value"=1),false)

materials_ledger_check.name: materials_ledger_check
materials_ledger_check.value: coalesce("materials"."minimum_quantity",0)>=0 and coalesce("materials"."maximum_quantity",0)>=0 and coalesce("materials"."opening_quantity",0)>=0 and coalesce("materials"."received_quantity",0)>=0 and coalesce("materials"."issued_quantity",0)>=0 and coalesce("materials"."opening_amount",0)>=0 and coalesce("materials"."received_amount",0)>=0 and coalesce("materials"."issued_amount",0)>=0 and coalesce("materials"."balance_amount",0)>=0
